from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class BasicEpsRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single Basic Earnings Per Share figure extracted from one financial report."""
    fiscal_year: str = Field(description="The fiscal year the EPS figure applies to (e.g., '2021')")
    basic_eps_value: float = Field(description="The reported Basic Earnings Per Share value")
    report_fiscal_year: str = Field(description="The fiscal year end of the filing document (e.g., '2021' for the 2021 10-K)")
    company_name: str = Field(description="The company name as stated in the document")
    currency: str = Field(description="The currency of the reported value (e.g., 'USD')", default="USD")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all EPS data points extracted from the provided financial documents."""
    eps_records: List[BasicEpsRecord] = Field(description="List of all Basic Earnings Per Share records found across the documents")
